hook: Hold your own in a real discussion: weigh your claims, report what others said and switch smoothly between du and Sie.
intro: The closing conversation of this module — and of this stage of the course — in your own AI assistant with voice on: a discussion on a cultural or social question in which you present a graded, hedged position, relay what others say, shift register when the tutor switches from informal to formal, and keep the thread cohesive. Copy the exercise in, say 'Los geht's', answer in full sentences; the score and corrections come at the end. The tutor listens for: subjective modals with the right degree (dürfte, könnte, muss) and past infinitives, hearsay with soll, hedges (man könnte den Eindruck gewinnen, gelinde gesagt), one well-placed idiom, register-appropriate requests (Wäre es Ihnen möglich, …), and cohesive openers (Tatsächlich …, Gleichwohl …, Ein solcher …). This is a real discussion in rehearsal — the kind you have at work, in a seminar or over dinner.
tips[0].title: Grade, relay, hedge
tips[0].text: Das dürfte zutreffen, … · Kritiker sollen eingewandt haben, dass … · Man könnte den Eindruck gewinnen, … · Ich wage zu bezweifeln, dass … Four moves that sound sophisticated and commit you to nothing you can't defend.
tips[0].check.why: soll with a past infinitive relays hearsay (is said to); will means the subject claims it himself, muss is a firm conclusion.
tips[0].visual.moves[0].label: Grade
tips[0].visual.moves[1].label: Relay
tips[0].visual.moves[2].label: Hedge
tips[1].title: Register on demand
tips[1].text: Informal: Kannst du mal …? Ich find's gut. Formal: Wäre es Ihnen möglich, …? Ich halte das für gelungen. When the tutor switches to Sie, switch everything — pronouns, verbs, idioms, particles.
tips[1].check.why: A register switch has to be complete: Sie-form pronoun (Ihnen) and the formal Konjunktiv frame together.
tips[2].title: Open each turn with a pointer
tips[2].text: Tatsächlich …, Ein solcher Einwand …, Dabei …, Gleichwohl … — start with something that refers to what was just said, and the discussion holds together.
tips[2].check.why: Ein derartiger Einwand points straight back to what was just said, so the discussion holds together.
remember[0]: dürfte / soll / man könnte / ich wage zu bezweifeln.
remember[1]: Switch register whole; open with a pointer.
exam: A hedged, well-argued discussion is what the C1 exam's speaking part asks for — and what a real debate needs.
